svg.title: The 50 thinkers, their lives: 36 lives from 470 BCE to 2026

g.text: 3 px a year in every era; a cut (≈) hides a stretch of more than 60 empty years. Red: cited by the paper. ▸ still living. Point at a life for its years.

svg.text: Not drawn, no dates found: Gregory Wolfe, Boaz Barak, Arfon M. Smith, Gwern Branwen, Sandy Maguire, Mark D. Wilkinson, personX, Pamela Samuelson, Marcus Baffa.
